full.name: Atlas Command Catalog
full.description: Preset catalog that describes the commands available to Atlas assets.

commands.name: ADSB Monitoring
commands.description: Monitor a geographic area for ADS-B traffic using a geofeature entity (polygon or circle shape).

geofeature_id.description: The identifier of the geofeature entity to monitor. The geofeature must be a polygon or circle shape, not a point or line.

commands.name: AIS Monitoring
commands.description: Monitor a maritime region for AIS traffic using a specified geofeature.

geofeature_id.description: The identifier of the maritime geofeature entity to monitor. The geofeature should represent a sea area.

commands.name: Move to Location
commands.description: Command an asset to move to a specific geographic location specified by latitude, longitude, and altitude.

altitude.description: Target altitude in meters above sea level.

commands.name: Get Signal Strength
commands.description: Read the current RF signal strength from the antenna and create a track entity at the projected point ahead of the asset's heading.

commands.name: RF Calibrate
commands.description: Capture and store a new RF baseline sample on the transceiver-attached asset.

tag.description: Optional operator tag for the baseline capture, such as an angle, location, or scenario label.

freq.description: Optional center frequency in Hz. Defaults to the scanner's configured frequency.

rate.description: Optional sample rate in samples per second. Defaults to the scanner's configured rate.

gain.description: Optional RF gain value. Defaults to the scanner's configured gain.

ant.description: Optional antenna selection, for example RX2. Defaults to the scanner's configured antenna.

duration.description: Optional capture duration in seconds. Defaults to the scanner's configured duration.

commands.name: RF Scan
commands.description: Capture a live RF sample, compare it to the stored baseline, and return the scan result.

tag.description: Optional operator tag for the scan, such as an angle, location, or scenario label.

freq.description: Optional center frequency in Hz. Defaults to the scanner's configured frequency.

rate.description: Optional sample rate in samples per second. Defaults to the scanner's configured rate.

gain.description: Optional RF gain value. Defaults to the scanner's configured gain.

ant.description: Optional antenna selection, for example RX2. Defaults to the scanner's configured antenna.

duration.description: Optional capture duration in seconds. Defaults to the scanner's configured duration.

band_hz.description: Optional analysis bandwidth in Hz for the IQ comparison step.

mean_abs_db.description: Optional mean absolute PSD delta threshold in dB.

peak_delta_db.description: Optional peak delta threshold in dB.

commands.name: Arm Test
commands.description: Run a rover arm/disarm test sequence on the target asset.

commands.name: Motor Test
commands.description: Briefly pulse rover throttle to confirm the drive motor responds, then return to neutral and disarm.

duration_s.description: Optional throttle pulse duration in seconds. Default is 1.0.

throttle_pwm.description: Optional throttle PWM override to send during the pulse. Default is 1600.

commands.name: Emergency Disarm
commands.description: Immediately attempt to disarm the rover using the direct recovery path.

commands.name: Hold Position
commands.description: Command the rover asset to stop and hold its current position.

commands.name: Return to Home
commands.description: Command the rover asset to return to its recorded home point using RTL.

commands.name: Goto
commands.description: Command the rover asset to navigate toward a target GPS coordinate.

arrival_radius.description: Optional arrival radius in meters. Default is 2.5.

minimum.name: Atlas Command Catalog
minimum.description: Preset catalog that describes the commands available to Atlas assets.
